headline: Junior Data & Software Engineer
summary: AI Engineering graduate with distinction who builds dependable data pipelines, Python services, and cloud-ready applications. Experienced in turning raw and inconsistent inputs into validated structured data, designing backend and persistence layers, and automating delivery with containers and CI/CD. Brings a practical engineering mindset and enjoys translating operational problems into maintainable technical solutions.
internship_bullets: Built a Python data pipeline that processes echocardiographic DICOM studies, extracts measurements with OCR and image processing, and exports structured JSON.
Designed resumable batch processing, validation queues, review tooling, logging, and traceable outputs for large clinical datasets.
Optimised a metadata-guided OpenCV matching workflow from roughly 21 hours to 23 minutes on one representative run.
apolloon_bullets: Built a paid local-first application with React, TypeScript, Express, Electron, SQLite, tRPC, and Socket.IO.
Translated real operator requirements into imports, exports, data validation, realtime synchronisation, replication, monitoring, and resilient failover.
